description.value: A forested Parks Canada drive-in campground minutes from the Swartz Bay ferry terminal, with bike-friendly walk-in sites and direct access to the Lochside Cycling Trail linking Swartz Bay to downtown Victoria; expect some road noise from the adjacent highway.

address.value: 10740 McDonald Park Road, North Saanich, BC V8L 5S5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Parks Canada website explicitly describes SMONEĆTEN Campground as suitable 'for campers, RVers, and cyclists,' and lists cycling-specific features including 'Bike-friendly walk-in sites close to entrance in pleasant wooded area' and 'Great access to the Lochside Cycling Trail.' Potable water and pit toilets are confirmed on the campground info list. Reservations are confirmed via reservation.pc.gc.ca. No evidence found for showers, laundry, device charging, or other unlisted amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM address lacks city and postal code; website confirms full address as 10740 McDonald Park Road, North Saanich, BC V8L 5S5
Campground is not staffed; Parks Canada staff conduct periodic rounds only
Website notes visitors should expect some road noise from adjacent highway
Described as 'primitive campsites' — pit toilets only, no flush facilities or showers mentioned
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Parks Canada campground that explicitly welcomes cyclists with dedicated bike-friendly walk-in sites and direct Lochside Trail access, minutes from the Swartz Bay ferry terminal — an ideal touring cyclist stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: Seasonal operation May 15 to September 30. The campground is part of Gulf Islands National Park Reserve. The Canada Strong Pass (2026) offers free admission and 25% off camping.

wow_evidence: Bike-friendly walk-in sites close to entrance in pleasant wooded area … Great access to the Lochside Cycling Trail
